systems.name: Moodle Workplace
systems.note: The paid distribution, sold only through certified partners. No free tier and no public sandbox, so documentation is the ceiling of what anyone can check without buying it.
systems.unknownReason: not covered by the Moodle Workplace documentation read on 2026-09-23; the product is partner gated and nobody drove it

systems.name: ILIAS
systems.note: Driven on demo.ilias.de, ILIAS 10.11, as the published teacher account benno. A sandbox category, course, study programme and test were created and their settings screens read. No admin account is published and the administration area silently redirects, so every rating that lives there stays unknown. docu.ilias.de is login gated, so there is essentially no usable vendor-docs evidence.
systems.unknownReason: outside the 55 rows the 2026-09-24 drive on demo.ilias.de covered, or behind the administration area no published account reaches

systems.name: Totara
systems.note: A GPLv3 Moodle fork built for corporate and government compliance. Code access needs a subscription and there is no public demo, so documentation is the ceiling. This is the column where the evidence is thinnest relative to the threat.
systems.unknownReason: not covered by the Totara documentation read on 2026-09-23; the code needs a subscription and nobody drove it

systems.name: Chamilo
systems.note: Read from source on chamilo/chamilo-lms master, the 3.0 line released 2026-09-09, plus docs.chamilo.org. The free campus was NOT registered on: its Terms require each account to be registered by the person it belongs to and ban automated scanning, so a bot-created teacher account would breach both. Two rows are driven unauthenticated (the shop and the language menu). A human who registers themselves could convert most of these to driven in an hour. Note that LTI, xAPI and cmi5, plagiarism and proctoring are all PLUGINS, so any given instance may have them off.
systems.unknownReason: not settled from the chamilo-lms 3.0 source tree and vendor docs read on 2026-09-24; the campus Terms forbid a bot-registered account

systems.name: iSpring Learn
systems.note: Proprietary per-seat SaaS, no self-host, non-EU vendor. Included because its marketing targets our exact wedge: certificate expiry and renewal notifications. A 30-day trial makes it partly drivable.
systems.unknownReason: not covered by the iSpring Learn documentation read on 2026-09-23; the trial was not taken
